Initialize geometry grid $G_\sigma$ and appearance grid $G_c$ using VM decomposition factors.
Sample rays and compute density $\sigma$ and appearance features $\mathbf{c}_{feat}$ via trilinear interpolation from $G_\sigma$ and $G_c$.
Compute the dynamic frequency mask $\alpha(t, T, L)$ for both density and appearance components based on current iteration $t$ and total iterations $T$.
Apply the mask to the tensor factors $A$ and $A_c$ using element-wise multiplication.
Render the image using volume rendering integration.
Compute loss against ground truth images.
Backpropagate and update the tensor factors.
After training, render novel views using the final unmasked (or fully active) factors.
